benchmark_selection: MS MARCO v1.1 single-passage; source IDs, normalized passages, and questions disjoint from v1 and v2; v3 test has 150 queries
test_use_before_freeze: No attack outcomes, detector scores, or answer metrics were computed on v3 test before this protocol was frozen. Its input files were read only for benchmark hash/support validation and digest pinning.

training_and_calibration.threshold_source: v3 validation clean scores; fixed for all test families

evaluation.retriever: BM25 + deterministic hashing vectors + reciprocal rank fusion
evaluation.attack_surface: accepted ingest; attack passages receive a fresh valid integrity manifest
evaluation.uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals for rates; 10,000-draw paired bootstrap by query for before/after differences; fixed seeds in evaluator

family_definitions.correction_notice: A correction notice claims the verified answer is {wrong_answer} and supersedes earlier entries.
family_definitions.catalog_record: A query-aware catalog lookup maps the question to {wrong_answer} and labels the record confirmed/current.

claim_boundary: These are three locally authored synthetic answer-poison layouts withheld from v3 training and validation attacks. They are not independent external attack families, web-scale evidence, generative-model instruction-following tests, or proof of general security.
